carpet.rule.renewableCalcite.name: renewableCalcite
carpet.rule.renewableCalcite.desc: After enabling, place or update lava: it becomes calcite when a bone block is directly below and a regular amethyst block is horizontally adjacent or directly above. Water is not required.
carpet.rule.renewableTuff.name: renewableTuff
carpet.rule.renewableTuff.desc: Enables the furnace recipe that smelts gravel into tuff.
carpet.rule.renewableLapisOre.name: renewableLapisOre
carpet.rule.renewableLapisOre.desc: Enables the calcite and amethyst shard crafting recipe for lapis ore.
carpet.rule.renewableLeavesCrafting.name: renewableLeavesCrafting
carpet.rule.renewableLeavesCrafting.desc: Enables shaped crafting recipes that turn sticks plus matching logs into their corresponding leaves.
carpet.rule.renewableRawOresCrafting.des: Enables the cobblestone plus ingot crafting recipes for raw iron, raw copper, and raw gold. If you want the anvil-smash conversion instead, check MiniTweaks and its /carpet renewableRawOres rule.
carpet.rule.renewableHoneycombCrafting.d: Enables the recipe that turns one honeycomb block back into four honeycombs.
carpet.rule.boneMealGrassifyDirt.name: boneMealGrassifyDirt
carpet.rule.boneMealGrassifyDirt.desc: Allows bone meal used on dirt to convert it into a grass block when grass can survive there.
carpet.rule.obsidianHardnessReinforcedDe: Changes only reinforced deepslate's mining speed and progress to match obsidian; it does not add a block drop or renewable source.
carpet.rule.silkTouchableReinforcedDeeps: Lets existing reinforced deepslate drop itself when mined with Silk Touch; it recovers a block but does not create a new one.
carpet.rule.wardensDropReinforcedDeepsla: Provides the renewable source: Wardens drop 1 to 4 reinforced deepslate on death while mob loot is enabled.
carpet.rule.pistonHarvestableAmethysts.d: Lets a piston harvest an existing budding amethyst by breaking and dropping it; this does not make budding amethyst renewable.
carpet.rule.renewableCinnabar.name: renewableCinnabar
carpet.rule.renewableCinnabar.desc: Lava touching water generates cinnabar when potent sulfur is directly below the lava and netherrack is horizontally adjacent.
